translation: Ad d-ruḥeɣ ɣef wennum-aɣent iɣsan (n lɣella): ad k-d-yaweḍ ungazen (aberzɛaben), iɣerdan yettwaḥeqqren deg wul, tidyanin i d-yeqqimen, d tid n muḥend-nneɣ; ad nessemselsi tiɣawsiwin n teqbuct (tibellarin), ad nesseɛzil izan d tẓurin; ad nessemsel, ad nesseɣli, ad nessencel izerfan-nneɣ — d ayen ur nessin ara mliḥ, s lmut n tmesyifin, d lmut-is (n yiman-nneɣ). Neslu i Yahwe deg wayen akk, deg wayen ur nessin ara mliḥ, deg wayen ur neḥbis ara deg-s ara nissin. Neslu i Yahwe deg wayen akk n tidyanin-nneɣ, deg wayen i d-yettɣimin deg lqel, deg wayen iɣef ur nessin ara mliḥ ayen ara n-d-yaf. Ad nessin, ad nessin tidyanin, ad nessin tidyanin n tidyanin-nneɣ, ad nessin tidyanin, tidyanin, ad nessin tidyanin-nneɣ, ad nessin tidyanin, ad nessin tidyanin n tidyanin, tidyanin n tidyanin n tidyanin n tidyanin n tidyanin.
